entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk you sent me. My order number is VF88602.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm pulling up your order now for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What kind of question is that? It's broken! It's completely defective. The thing is not working at all! It won't sync with my phone, it won't sync with my app. I've wasted hours on this! I want my money back, now! Don't you dare try to troubleshoot this with me, I want a manager!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I am very sorry for the trouble this has caused. A manager isn't necessary, I can handle this for you. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for your order.
You'd better. I've had it for a little over two weeks and if I don't get a refund, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. This is ridiculous.

I understand. One moment... Okay, I see the band was delivered to you 16 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund. I can absolutely process that for you right now.
Oh. You can? So you'll just give me a full refund, no hassle?

Yes, of course. I apologize again that the product was defective. I've just initiated the refund to your original payment method. I am also sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Please package the VeloBand, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Okay. That's... good. Thank you. That's all I wanted.
You are very welcome. You should see the funds back in your account within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
